title: Spigadolce | Pugliese Pasta Traditions — Voluntary Demonstrations by Riccardina Burdo

hero.heading: Keeping Pugliese Pasta Traditions Alive
hero.subheading: Voluntary demonstrations and workshops on handmade Puglian pasta — orecchiette, cavatelli, strascinati and more. Shared freely, for the joy of passing on a living tradition.

intro.text: Orecchiette, cavatelli, strascinati, troccoli — the handmade pasta forms of Puglia have been shaped on wooden boards for generations, passed down through families without a recipe ever written down. I learnt them at my grandparents' side in Andria, and I share them today with the same spirit: freely, with joy, and with great love for this living heritage.

howItWorks.heading: What to Expect
howItWorks.subheading: A hands-on experience in the ancient art of Pugliese pasta-making — shared freely and with joy

steps.title: Watch & Learn
steps.description: I demonstrate each pasta form by hand — orecchiette, cavatelli, strascinati and more — sharing the gestures and rhythms passed down through generations of Apulian women.

steps.title: Try It Yourself
steps.description: You shape the dough alongside me. No experience needed — the technique lives in the hands, and there is no better way to learn than by doing.

steps.title: Share the Tradition
steps.description: We cook and taste together. You leave with the knowledge, the feel of the dough, and the recipes to carry on the tradition at home.
